SELECT , (SELECT MAX(O.ORDER_DATE) FROM ORDERS O WHERE O.CUSTOMER_ID = C.CUSTOMER_ID) AS lastOrderDate, P1.TOTAL_PAYMENT AS totalPayment FROM CUSTOMER C LEFT JOIN ( SELECT PM.CUSTOMER_ID, SUM(PM.PAYMENT_AMOUNT) AS TOTAL_PAYMENT FROM PAYMENT PM WHERE PM.ORDER_ID IN (SELECT OD.ORDER_ID FROM ORDER_DETAIL OD WHERE OD.QUANTITY > 0) GROUP BY PM.CUSTOMER_ID ) P1 ON P1.CUSTOMER_ID = C.CUSTOMER_ID
C.REGION_CODE = #regionCode#
SELECT C.CUSTOMER_ID, C.CUSTOMER_NAME FROM CUSTOMER C UNION ALL SELECT A.CUSTOMER_ID, A.CUSTOMER_NAME FROM ARCHIVED_CUSTOMER A
